decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the game using low-cost spells and creatures. By utilizing cards like Snap, Counterspell, and Spell Pierce, along with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while dealing damage quickly. The deck also includes card draw and card selection options like Mental Note, Ponder, and Brainstorm to ensure consistency and keep pressure on the opponent. With a strong emphasis on tempo and disruption, the Mono Blue Aggro deck looks to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap artifacts, utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer, Frogmite, and Ornithopter, and then enhance them with cards like All That Glitters to deliver a fast and powerful attack. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind help to refill your hand and keep the pressure on your opponent. The deck also includes cards like Metallic Rebuke for disruption and Thraben Inspector for additional card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong affinity-based aggro strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy by utilizing a combination of cheap creatures, spells, and card draw to overwhelm the opponent. By efficiently using counterspells and tempo plays, the deck aims to control the pace of the game while pressuring the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cheap card draw spells like Brainstorm and Thought Scour assists in quickly cycling through the deck to find key pieces. Additionally, the deck incorporates high-power finishers like Cryptic Serpent and Tolarian Terror to close out games swiftly.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost spells and creatures. By utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Chain Lightning, along with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion to create additional damage and card advantage. In essence, the deck looks to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful aggression.

The deck focuses on creating a solid defense with cards like Crypt Rats and Chainer's Edict while also generating value through cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Ichor Wellspring. The deck aims to control the game by removing threats with cards like Cast Down and Snuff Out, while also utilizing cards like Reckoner's Bargain and Deadly Dispute to maintain card advantage. The deck utilizes Golgari and Jund mana sources to ensure the right colors of mana are available for casting spells, and creates additional blockers with tokens generated from Khalni Garden and Golgari Rot Farm.

This Pauper 1 vs 1 Aggro - Affinity deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and sacrificing them for value. By generating a steady flow of artifacts and casting spells at a low cost, the deck can overwhelm opponents with its aggression and efficiency. The key strategy involves utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer and Gearseeker Serpent as threats, while also maintaining resources with cards such as Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute. By efficiently managing resources and leveraging the synergies of artifact creatures, this deck aims to quickly outpace opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using removal spells like Defile and Cast Down, as well as sacrificing creatures for value with cards like Deadly Dispute and Chainer's Edict. The deck also aims to generate value with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Thorn of the Black Rose. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Crypt Rats and Avenging Hunter to help clear the board. The mana base includes Khalni Garden and Golgari Rot Farm to help ramp and fix mana. The goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent while establishing a board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive red deck that focuses on dealing damage quickly. By utilizing cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Chain Lightning, along with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while maintaining a steady stream of threats. Kuldotha Rebirth and Experiment Synthesizer provide additional creature tokens and card advantage to keep the pressure on, while cards like Reckless Impulse and Dwarven Forge-Chanter help to maintain a steady flow of cards and resources for the aggressive strategy.

The main idea behind this deck is to play aggressively with low cost spells and creatures, focusing on dealing damage quickly to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Galvanic Blast, as well as creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Voldaren Epicure, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient damage. Additionally, cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Dwarven Forge-Chanter provide additional value and efficiency, while Wrenn's Resolve can help protect key creatures. This deck is all about speed and aggression in order to win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on ramping up quickly with mana acceleration cards like Wild Growth and Arbor Elf, allowing you to play powerful spells like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst early on to disrupt your opponent's mana base. The creatures in this deck, such as Boarding Party and Annoyed Altisaur, have high power to quickly close out games. The inclusion of Skred and Relic of Progenitus helps to control the board and disrupt your opponent's graveyard strategies. Overall, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By utilizing low-cost cards such as Monastery Swiftspear and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to deal damage efficiently and efficiently. The inclusion of artifacts like Implement of Combustion and Experimental Synthesizer helps to both fuel additional damage and provide card advantage. The deck's goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly enhance and empower a small creature with auras in order to deal significant damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Slippery Bogle and Gladecover Scout to protect the enchanted creature from removal spells. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive playstyle of the deck.

Card draw and graveyard manipulation cards like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour help maintain hand advantage and fuel the graveyard for bonuses.
